conclusions.primary_confirmed_routing_issue: The agent's internal acceptance suite selection used arc-bench-web--keep while the Run task is arc-bench-lite--keep. This makes the internal 29/32 acceptance result a non-matching-suite result.
conclusions.primary_confirmed_execution_issue: Five implementation turns hit the 900 second Octos cap; later repair turns were bounded by request guards and remaining budget, leaving three final internal nodes unverified.
conclusions.primary_confirmed_platform_symptom: The final official suite reached the application and produced 14 Playwright timeouts, all waiting for missing controls or state, with no assertion-status failures.
conclusions.secondary_confirmed_provider_issue: One REQ-2.6.2 repair turn terminated with an upstream proxy_error unexpected EOF.
conclusions.implementation_root_cause_status: The exact final-code causes behind each missing control/state remain phase4 read-only diagnosis work; phase3 does not infer them from timeout symptoms alone.

optimization_candidates.action: Make internal acceptance task-key strict: require arc-bench-lite--keep suite identity, fail closed on a web-suite mismatch, and report the selected suite in the run contract.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents false 29/32 confidence and directs repair turns at the official contract.

optimization_candidates.action: Mirror final worker and timeout settings during self-acceptance (workers=1, official suite, 10s test timeout) and run a small targeted smoke before cumulative suites.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces validation drift and separates UI contract failures from harness latency.

optimization_candidates.action: Bound each node by a small inspect -> patch -> targeted test loop; stop repeated file-path/tool retries and avoid full rewrites when the failure is a single locator contract.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces 900s turn hits, request-budget guards and unfinished repair states.

optimization_candidates.action: Reserve repair budget for nodes whose official-task test actually fails; do not spend late budget on cross-suite cumulative failures.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Improves repair convergence before the remaining budget becomes negative.

optimization_candidates.action: Keep startup/server cleanup isolated and assert no process accumulation after each smoke; 402 stray processes were reaped postflight.
optimization_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces environmental noise and possible later interaction instability; not proven as the final root cause in this Run.
